# Bitsbay Ltd
> Software development agency building custom web apps, mobile apps, SaaS platforms, and Amazon seller growth services for businesses in the US, UK and Pakistan.

## Services
- [App Development](https://bitsbayltd.com/services/app-development): iOS/Android & cross-platform apps
- [Web Applications](https://bitsbayltd.com/services/web-applications): React, Node, SaaS platforms
- [Product Engineering](https://bitsbayltd.com/services/product-engineering): MVP to scale
- [Amazon Services](https://bitsbayltd.com/services/amazon): account management, PPC, listings
